lessons.title: Reading: The Rise of Remote Work
lessons.context: A short passage about how remote work has changed modern careers.

paragraphs.uz: So'nggi yillarda masofaviy ish tobora ommalashib bormoqda.
paragraphs.en: In recent years, remote work has been becoming increasingly popular.

paragraphs.uz: Ko'plab kompaniyalar xodimlariga uydan ishlash imkoniyatini berishmoqda.
paragraphs.en: Many companies are giving their employees the opportunity to work from home.

paragraphs.uz: Bu tendensiya ish va shaxsiy hayot muvozanatini yaxshilashga yordam berdi.
paragraphs.en: This trend has helped improve the balance between work and personal life.

paragraphs.uz: Biroq, ba'zi mutaxassislar jamoaviy hamkorlikning susayishidan xavotirda.
paragraphs.en: However, some experts are concerned about the decline in team collaboration.

paragraphs.uz: Texnologiyaning rivojlanishi bu jarayonni ancha osonlashtirdi.
paragraphs.en: The development of technology has made this process much easier.

paragraphs.uz: Kelajakda gibrid ish modeli yanada keng tarqalishi mumkin.
paragraphs.en: In the future, the hybrid work model may become even more widespread.

paragraphs.uz: Har bir kompaniya o'ziga mos strategiyani tanlashi lozim.
paragraphs.en: Each company must choose a strategy that suits it.
